lines.en: Did you meet the new neighbor this morning?
Yes, I did. She is very friendly.
Is she kind? She smiled at me yesterday.
Very kind and polite. She always says hello.
lines.ko: 아주 친절하고 예의 발라요. 항상 먼저 인사해요.

lines.en: Her son seems shy, but clever.
Yes. He is a serious, careful child.
Will we have them for dinner next week?
Good idea. I will ask them tomorrow.
Thank you. Honest, kind neighbors are a gift.
I agree. We are happy to have them.
Grandma, I broke a cup at school today.
Really? Did you tell your teacher?
Yes. I was nervous, but I told her after class.
You were honest and brave. I'm proud of you.
She was kind when I told her.
Good teachers are patient. Honest words are always safe.
lines.ko: 좋은 선생님은 참을성이 있어요. 정직한 말은 언제나 안전해요.

lines.en: Grandma, is it hard to be brave?
Sometimes. But a careful, polite child can be brave.
lines.ko: 가끔요. 하지만 조심스럽고 예의 바른 아이도 용감할 수 있어요.

lines.en: Will you be proud if I'm honest next time?
Always. That's my clever one. Let's have tea.
lines.ko: 언제나요. 역시 영리한 우리 손녀예요. 차 마셔요.
